column3: KAZAN-YU — THE DESCENT version 2: a museum-poster style vertical cutaway cross-section of the whole volcano, cut open like a dollhouse, showing every level from SUMMIT down to B4 with each place drawn in miniature in its correct position and labeled with a leader line. Glowing teal water drawn as one continuous stream with arrows from the crater spring all the way down to the sea at the Wave Grotto, with temperatures marked along the way. Title top-left. Dark charcoal background.

Isometric 3D cutaway of the entire volcano with a wedge removed, revealing the stacked interior levels like an architectural model: crater pool at the top, terraces on the outside slope, suites in the north cliff, arrival hall, B1 thermal level, B2 restaurant over the river, B3 great cavern water park, B4 magma chamber. Small figures for scale, tiny warm lights everywhere, numbered callouts with a legend. Title "KAZAN-YU — HOW IT FITS TOGETHER".

THE WATER'S JOURNEY: an elegant infographic poster tracing the single hot spring from source to sea as a glowing teal ribbon winding top-left to bottom-right, passing small circular vignette illustrations of each place it feeds in order (Spring Source, Caldera Crown, Cascade Terraces, Suites, Mist Corridors, Underground River / Kawagiri, Thunder Curtain Falls, Rimstone Terraces, Lazy River, Geyser Plaza, Wave Grotto, the Sea), each with its temperature in °C, cooling from 44 °C to 30 °C, with the ribbon colour shifting from amber-hot to cool teal.

KAZAN-YU GUEST ROUTES: a stylised transit-map diagram (like a Tokyo metro map) on dark background. Coloured lines for routes: amber "Mist Path" walkways, white "Lift" between levels, teal "River Boat" from the boat landing to Kawagiri, magenta "Magma Slide" express from B1 to B3, plus a "Cable Lift" to the summit. Every place is a station dot labeled with its name and level band (SUMMIT, GROUND, B1, B2, B3, B4) as horizontal bands. Small pictogram icons beside stations. Legend box.

Architectural exploded axonometric sheet: the floor plans of each level (SUMMIT, GROUND, B1, B2, B3, B4) drawn as separate translucent horizontal plates stacked vertically with space between them, connected by dashed vertical lines showing lifts, stairs, the waterfall drop and the slide. Each plate shows its rooms in plan with teal water and labels. Presentation board style on charcoal paper, fine white linework, title block "KAZAN-YU — LEVEL STACK".

Aerial bird's-eye illustrated site plan of the volcano island at dusk seen from high above at a slight angle: the crater with the Caldera Crown Infinity Pool and moon deck on the rim, the Cascade Terraces pouring down the south face, the suite windows glowing in the north cliff, the Basalt Gate entrance and approach road at the base, and on the coast the sea-cave mouth of the Wave Grotto glowing teal where the spring meets the ocean. Labeled callouts, compass rose, scale bar, mist and clouds around the slopes.

Long horizontal cinematic cutaway section following the underground river from left to right: on the left the river flows beneath the KAWAGIRI restaurant decks on wooden beams (water-curtain pods, neon, the boat landing with a lantern boat); in the middle the river pours over a lip and plunges as THUNDER CURTAIN FALLS into the vast AQUA CAVERN below; on the right the water spreads into RIMSTONE TERRACES, GEYSER PLAZA and the LAVA TUBE LAZY RIVER, with the WAVE GROTTO opening to the sea at the far right. Labeled with leader lines, people for scale.
